classification.difficultyReason: Combine position vectors, calculate magnitudes and use quadrant reasoning for directions.

content.prompt:
Given $\overrightarrow{OA}=\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix}$ and $\overrightarrow{OB}=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}$, find the magnitude and direction of each vector. Give magnitudes to 1 decimal place and directions as angles of inclination to the nearest degree.

Draw a sketch to check your answer.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{AB}&=\overrightarrow{OB}-\overrightarrow{OA}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}-4\\-1\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{AB}|&=\sqrt{(-4)^2+(-1)^2}\\&=\sqrt{17}\approx4.1\\\alpha&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac14\right)\\\theta&=180^\circ+\alpha\\&\approx194^\circ\end{aligned}$

The vector points left and down, agreeing with the sketch.

spec.description: Authored sketch checking the directed segment from A to B.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{BA}&=\overrightarrow{OA}-\overrightarrow{OB}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}4\\1\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{BA}|&=\sqrt{4^2+1^2}\\&=\sqrt{17}\approx4.1\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac14\right)\\&\approx14^\circ\end{aligned}$

The vector points right and up, agreeing with the sketch.

spec.description: Authored sketch checking the directed segment from B to A.

answer.worked:
$\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{OB}&=\begin{pmatrix}5\\2\end{pmatrix}+\begin{pmatrix}1\\1\end{pmatrix}\\&=\begin{pmatrix}6\\3\end{pmatrix}\\|\overrightarrow{OA}+\overrightarrow{OB}|&=\sqrt{6^2+3^2}\\&=3\sqrt5\approx6.7\\\theta&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac36\right)\\&\approx27^\circ\end{aligned}$

The resultant points right and up, agreeing with the sketch.
